title: Strategic window one-pager and ask triage
body:
Purpose and context:

This is a compact, action-focused one-pager for the mid-year strategic window: consolidate priorities for the next 6–10 weeks, align exec asks for the next all-hands, and triage cross-functional blockers that require immediate commitment. The target audience is the executive team, GTM leads, and one delegated owner per major ask.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Big picture: We need to protect inference reliability and cost per token while enabling 2 strategic product launches (dedicated autoscaling feature and the Optimize recommendations panel).
- Main asks: commit headroom for a 3-week Dedicated autoscale performance spike test; allocate an Enablement sprint for Optimize evaluation harness; dedicate SRE runbook updates with a two-week blackout window for rollout testing.
- Outcome we want by late Q3: clear rollout plan for autoscale, a validated cost/perf delta for Optimize suggestions on 3 customer profiles, and consolidated SLAs for Private deployments.

Proposed high-level OKRs (draft) — remainder of fiscal half:
Objective A - Keep production inference stable and predictable at scale
KR A1: Reduce 95th percentile token latency for hosted-critical routes by 15% vs baseline (measured over 14-day windows).
KR A2: Cut anomaly-driven incidents impacting customer success by 40% quarter-over-quarter (tracked in Ops incident list).
KR A3: Publish SLO/SLA calibration for Private customers and get legal sign-off on 2 template contracts.

Objective B - Deliver two product launches that materially improve unit economics
KR B1: Launch Dedicated autoscaling v1 with burst capacity policy and measure cost per token delta for 10 pilot customers.
KR B2: Ship Redwood Optimize recommendations panel MVP and run A/B evaluation vs control on embeddings-heavy workloads (3 customers).
KR B3: Produce 3 case studies showing >=20% cost reduction after applying Optimize suggestions.

Objective C - Developer experience and observability improvements to shrink time-to-detect and time-to-fix
KR C1: Reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) errors in serving runtime by 30% via instrumentation rollouts.
KR C2: Add model-level trace tags and expose per-route token cost in Console for top 20 internal routes.

Priority asks (who owns, what, when) — triaged items we need exec sign-off on:
1) Dedicated autoscale spike window (Owner: Marco Ruiz)
- What: Reserve +30% GPU cluster headroom for a 3-week controlled spike test across regions us-west1/eu-west1.
- Why: Validate latency and tail behavior with real traffic and fallback policies.
- When: Proposed window 2025-08-18 to 2025-09-07.
- Decision needed: Approve capacity budget and temporary customer routing to test tier.

2) Optimize evaluation sprint (Owner: Claire Nguyen)
- What: Two-week engineering sprint + data scientist support to run Optimize recommendations on 3 pilot workloads and record quality drift metrics.
- Why: Quantify cost/quality tradeoffs before public rollout.
- Resources: 1 Eng PM, 2 SWE, 1 Applied ML, 1 SRE.
- Decision needed: Green light to dedicate headcount and run on production-like data.

3) All-hands agenda + comms asks (Owner: Jon Park)
- What: 60-minute in-person all-hands (hybrid) with 3 exec updates + product demos + cross-team Q&A.
- Slots: Intro (10m), Exec round (15m — ops + product + GTM), Live demo (15m — autoscale & Optimize), Breakouts & Q/A (20m).
- Comms: Draft exec email and slide deck needs final review by 2025-08-14.
- Decision needed: Confirm venue capacity and exec presenters.

4) SRE runbook and maintenance blackout (Owner: Marta Silva)
- What: Finalize runbooks for autoscale failover and schedule soft blackout windows for non-critical deploys during test weeks.
- Why: Reduce noise and avoid unintended rollouts during spike tests.
- Decision needed: Approve blackout policy and exceptions.

Communication & all-hands plan (detailed timeline):
- 2025-08-07: Draft slides + speaker notes circulated to execs (owner: Jon).
- 2025-08-11: Slide review with CEO + COO (30m).
- 2025-08-14: Final slide deck; comms copy for staff email ready.
- 2025-08-18: Send pre-read with FAQ and pilot sign-up.
- 2025-09-02: All-hands (in-person hub + livestream).
- Post-event: publish recording and consolidated Q/A in #company-all and on Confluence by 2025-09-04.

Suggested all-hands talking points (short bullet prompts for execs):
- CEO: high-level thesis — why serving is the moat and what we expect in next 6–9 months. Call out customer momentum and enterprise pipeline.
- Head of Product: two launches and what success looks like; demo plan for Optimize.
- Head of Engineering: operational readiness for autoscale, what we need from teams during the spike window.
- Head of Customer Success: early adopter playbook and how pilot customers will be supported.

Risk register (top five):
- Risk 1: Autoscale test causes unexpected customer disruptions. Mitigation: staged routing + immediate fallback; SRE on-call escalation matrix.
- Risk 2: Optimize suggestions degrade output quality on certain prompts. Mitigation: guardrail thresholds and human-in-the-loop review for first 3 pilots.
- Risk 3: Insufficient capacity budget for spike test due to cloud spot market volatility. Mitigation: reserve committed nodes and use cross-region fallbacks.
- Risk 4: Key engineers tied up on critical production bug fixes. Mitigation: contingency schedule of secondary owners and pause non-essential work.
- Risk 5: Messaging confusion leading to misaligned expectations across GTM. Mitigation: single source of truth on Confluence and pre-read Q/A.

Open questions and decisions to surface in exec sync:
- What is the approved capacity cap ($) for autoscale testing? (Finance + Infra)
- Which customers should be considered for the first 3 Optimize pilots? (CS + Solutions Eng)
- Do we permit production traffic routing to experimental autoscale tier, or prefer synthetic traffic in a shadow mode?
- Timing: do we align the spike window with any external customer events or major releases?

Operational checklist (short):
- [ ] Finalize SRE runbook and on-call rotations for 8/18–9/07 (Marta).
- [ ] Allocate reserved nodes and update capacity plan (Marco + Infra).
- [ ] Prep Optimize evaluation harness and dataset snapshots (Claire).
- [ ] Draft all-hands deck and speaker notes (Jon).
- [ ] CS outreach to pilot customers and consent forms (Lead CS).

Appendix / notes to self (rough):
- Link to current OKR dashboard and gaps: see linked_artifacts.
- Suggested pilot customer candidates: acme-ai (high embedding), shoplytics (high throughput invoices), med-know (private deployment candidate).
- Quick reminder: coordinate legal on data handling for Optimize pilots.
- Slack channels to notify: #infra-ops, #product-launches, #cs-pilots, #company-all.

Next steps (next 7 days):
1) Exec decision on capacity and blackout policy (decision meeting 2025-08-05).
2) If approved, schedule infra changes and lock down spike window.
3) Align CS on pilot list and draft customer comms.
4) Finalize all-hands slide deck and circulate pre-read.

Notes (tone: working draft):
This doc is intentionally terse — the goal is to surface only the asks that need explicit exec decisions ahead of the all-hands. Please annotate inline with comments in Drive and flag anything that must shift timelines. If you're an owner above, add your single-line acceptance for the ask ("ok to proceed" or "need changes") in the comments by 2025-08-01 so decisions can be packaged for the 8/05 exec sync.

Unresolved/parking-lot items:
- Detail the cost estimate for the autoscale headroom (Finance to provide model).
- Runbook step for model rollback across dedicated pools (SRE to draft).
- GTM prep for customers we will approach for case studies (Marketing + Solutions).
